items.title: Existence of palette-alternating tree codes with Gilbert-Varshamov distance-rate tradeoff
items.author: Gil Cohen; Shahar Samocha
items.source_version: CCC2020 current formal29-page CC BY3.0 Unported publication;current ECCC TR20-014,not withdrawn historical TR19-147
items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine existence argument correlates a linear online four-symbol coloring across all paths,then alternates field and traced subfield palettes and simultaneously controls every phase and path length through entropy and geometric probability tails.

primary.label: Formal Theorem4 complete rate/distance quantifiers,GV comparison and stated field/subfield mechanism

proof_spans.label: Formal Section3 complete common linear online coloring,Claims10–12,union-bound existence and improved four-color support proof
Formal Section4 complete trace/palette construction,Claims16–18 and full all-phase entropy/geometric-tail proof of Theorem15/4

contexts.label: Formal definitions1/3,three-color obstruction,four-color support statement,and Section2 standard entropy preliminaries
Formal Section1.4 current interactive-application context,explicitness assumption and existing Gelles result; not counted
